title: Flow developer kit - node lockfile + installer that match a developer's ComfyUI to the shipped engine
description:
UMBRELLA: MPI-560 (phase 7 - community Flow submissions). Split out of MPI-532 on 2026-09-17 (Fabio).

TARGET: ready the day Cubric Studio 2.0 ships, so outside developers can build Flows and submit them for review from release day (with the registry card, same phase).

WHY: a Flow graph uses nodes from the custom-node packs the app pins. A developer whose ComfyUI carries a different pack version can build a graph with a node or widget users do not have, and it fails on their machines. The paid Flows (MPI-780) do not need this: MPI authors on G:\ComfyUi, which /mpi-bump-local-comfy keeps matched to the shipped engine.

SCOPE:
1. LOCKFILE - a developer-facing export of dev_configs/node_lock.json (ComfyUI core tag + commit, frontend package versions, every custom-node pack by repo + commit or tag). Generated, never hand-written; published with each release so a developer can match the version their users run.
2. INSTALLER - a script run against the developer's own ComfyUI folder: clones or checks out those exact pack commits, installs requirements for packs flagged installRequirements, and warns on a core/frontend mismatch. Never fork or vendor the packs.
3. The Flow package linter (MPI-532 phase 4, scripts/lint-flow-package.mjs) reads the same list for its node-class allowlist.
4. Docs: a section in docs/flow-packages.md (MPI-532).

READ FIRST: dev_configs/node_lock.json, js/data/modelConstants/nodesDeps.js, scripts/compile-node-deps.mjs, scripts/resolve-comfy-node.mjs, and the mpi-bump-local-comfy skill (the same job for MPI's own bench - reuse it, do not write a second one). Users never touch a terminal; this tool is for Flow DEVELOPERS, who may.

DEPENDS ON: MPI-532 (package format + linter).
